Map saved periodic-He energies and six-coordinate forces to unchanged independent references and criteria. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Assumptions, units and boundaries Audit saved six-coordinate FD and Gaussian/PW comparisons; source versions, local-only He GTH, XC/units/cell/electron count fixed. No new k/basis/cutoff scans. Artificial He2,4electrons,5bohr cell. Stored geometry/localGTH version/LDA_X+VWN/Libxc/PySCF/DFTK versions remain fixed in saved-data/periodic-he-reference.json. Energy hartree; force hartree/bohr. Editorial clarification Audit of stored6force components, energy differences and Gaussian/PW comparisons; zero new electronic solves. No new basis/k/cutoff scans, materials, metals or longMD claim. Adopted numerical method Audit arithmetic of saved energy differences, analytic forces and Gaussian/PW comparisons under the original bounds.
